scripts.build:test: pnpm run wasm:release && vite build --config vite.config.js --mode test
scripts.check: cargo check --workspace --all-targets && cargo check -p renderer-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && eslint vite.config.js playwright.config.js eslint.config.js web tests scripts
scripts.build: pnpm run wasm:release && vite build --config vite.config.js
scripts.e2e:smoke: pnpm run build:test && SOFT_RASTERIZER_E2E_MODE=headless playwright test --grep @smoke
scripts.e2e: pnpm run build:test && SOFT_RASTERIZER_E2E_MODE=headless playwright test
scripts.e2e:headed: pnpm run build:test && SOFT_RASTERIZER_E2E_MODE=headed playwright test --headed
